evidence: Reviewed .github/workflows/ci.yml, evidence.yml, release.yml @6ca3281. All six actions are `actions/*` (GitHub's official org) pinned to full 40-hex SHAs; the SHAs in every `uses:` line equal the SHAs in this table.

Permissions: each workflow sets top-level `contents: read` (evidence.yml and release.yml add `actions: read` only to download artifacts from another run). Elevated scopes are job-local: release.yml `attest` has id-token: write + attestations: write (needed by actions/attest) and `publish` has contents: write (release draft). No other job elevates; ci.yml (also called by release.yml) stays read-only.

All 14 actions/checkout uses (ci 7, release 5, evidence 2) set `persist-credentials: false`. GITHUB_TOKEN is passed only as GH_TOKEN/github-token to steps that need gh API or cross-run artifact download. No pull_request_target trigger; ci.yml's pull_request trigger runs with the read-only token.

Not verified by me: the GitHub commit-identity check (`gh api repos/<action>/commits/<sha>`; automatic) and the actions' own dist/runtime code (out of scope per the R36 trust assumption). I judged ownership from the `actions/` owner prefix in the workflows, not by a live GitHub query.

Re-review 2026-11-10 for candidate e240b70da748edc3c2bb3992d6f03f49eb4275c1 (previously 6ca3281): I read `git diff 6ca3281 e240b70 -- .github/workflows`; only ci.yml changed. New job `legacy-libreoffice (ubuntu-24.04, 3.14)` uses checkout 3d3c42e5 (persist-credentials: false), setup-python 6d4fd22b, download-artifact 9000827c and upload-artifact cf430e03: the same six reviewed SHAs, no new action. It declares no `permissions:` and so inherits the workflow's top-level `contents: read`; no new secrets, tokens, id-token or write scope. The only privileged step is `sudo apt-get install --no-install-recommends` of libreoffice-*-nogui on the hosted runner, which has no effect on repository permissions (apt packages are unpinned; that is not an action-ownership or token-scope issue). Other changes: a pytest marker filter (`not release and not soffice`) and a `trace` job `needs`/download of the new `legacy-libreoffice` artifact, both with the same pinned download-artifact. Ownership and workflow_permissions remain PASS for all six actions.
